title: 49 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Growth)
description:
Learn 49 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

PHRASE LIST

GROWTH · 成长
• Start where you are today - 从你现在的起点开始，慢慢来  [cong ni xianzai de qidian KAIshi, manman lai]
• Write down your goals clearly - 把目标写下来，才会更清楚  [ba mubiao XIExialaI, cai hui geng qingchu]
• Make mistakes, then adjust - 犯错没关系，立刻改进就好  [fan cuo mei guanxi, liji GAijin jiu hao]
• Practice the hard thing first - 先做最难的那件事，再轻松  [xian zuo zui nan de na jian shi, zai qing song]
• Let feedback reshape your habits - 别怕被指出来，改习惯会变强  [bie pa bei zhizhiLai, gai xi guan hui bian qiang]
• Speak up, even when nervous - 心里紧张也要表达，慢慢就顺了  [xinli jinzhang ye yao biao da, manman jiu shun le]

WISDOM · 智慧
• Stop repeating the same pattern - 别总重演同样的模式  [Bié zǒng zhòng yǎn tóngyàng de móshì]
• Before reacting, take one slow breath - 在回话前先慢慢吸一口气  [Zài huíhuà qián xiān mànmàn xī yì kǒu qì]
• Ask, then listen for the answer - 先问清楚，再认真听答案  [Xiān wèn qīngchu, zài rènzhēn tīng dá'àn]
• Clarify expectations, save future trouble - 把期待说清楚，少点以后麻烦  [Bǎ qīwàng shuō qīngchu, shǎo diǎn yǐhòu máfan]
• Choose actions that match your values - 做的事要对得起你的价值观  [Zuò de shì yào duì de qǐ nǐ de jiàzhíguān]
• Make room for mistakes, learn fast - 允许自己犯错，学得更快  [Yǔnxǔ zìjǐ fàncuò, xué de gèng kuài]

JOY · 快乐
• I feel light, like today works - 我觉得很轻松，今天真顺  [Wǒ juéde hěn qīngsōng, jīntiān zhēn shùn]
• Joy is showing up right now - 快乐正在向我走来  [Kuàilè zhèngzài xiàng wǒ zǒu lái]
• This made my whole day brighter - 这件事让我的一天都亮起来了  [Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ de yītiān dōu liàng qǐlái le]
• I’m smiling without trying - 我都没刻意就笑了  [Wǒ dōu méi kèyì jiù xiào le]
• Joy feels warm in my chest - 快乐在我胸口暖暖的  [Kuàilè zài wǒ xiōngkǒu nuǎn nuǎn de]
• Small wins still count, big time - 小小的胜利也算数，真的  [Xiǎoxiǎo de shènglì yě suàn shù, zhēn de]

DOCTOR & PHARMACY · 医生与药房
• What symptoms should I watch for? - 接下来我该注意哪些症状？  [Jiēxiàlái wǒ gāi zhùyì nǎxiē zhèngzhuàng?]
• Can you explain the diagnosis simply? - 你能用更简单的话解释诊断吗？  [Nǐ néng yòng gèng jiǎndān de huà jiěshì zhěnduàn ma?]
• Will this affect my work tomorrow? - 这会影响我明天上班吗？  [Zhè huì yǐngxiǎng wǒ míngtiān shàngbān ma?]
• Is there anything I should avoid? - 我需要避免什么吗？  [Wǒ xūyào bìmiǎn shénme ma?]
• Can I drink alcohol while taking this? - 吃这个药期间能喝酒吗？  [Chī zhège yào qījiān néng hē jiǔ ma?]
• What side effects might happen? - 可能会有哪些副作用？  [Kěnéng huì yǒu nǎxiē fùzuòyòng?]

WORK & OFFICE · 工作与办公室
• Can we sync on priorities? - 我们能对一下优先级吗？  [Wǒmen néng duì yíxià yōuxiānjí ma?]
• Please send the updated file. - 麻烦把更新后的文件发我。  [Máfan bǎ gēngxīn hòu de wénjiàn fā wǒ.]
• Who owns this task? - 这项工作谁负责？  [Zhè xiàng gōngzuò shuí fùzé?]
• Let’s clarify the deadline. - 我们先把截止时间说清楚。  [Wǒmen xiān bǎ jiézhǐ shíjiān shuō qīngchu.]
• I’ll handle it from here. - 从这里开始我来负责。  [Cóng zhèlǐ kāishǐ wǒ lái fùzé.]
• Need a quick status update. - 我想要一个简短的进展汇报。  [Wǒ xiǎng yào yí gè jiǎnduǎn de jìnzhan huìbào.]

COFFEE SHOP & BAKERY · 咖啡馆与面包店
• One more cup, please - 再来一杯，拜托  [zài lái yì bēi, BÀI tuō]
• What bread is fresh today? - 今天新鲜的面包是什么  [jīn tiān xīn xiān de miàn bāo shì shén me]
• This croissant smells amazing - 这个可颂闻起来太香了  [zhè ge kě sòng wén qǐ lái tài xiāng le]
• I’ll try the cinnamon bun - 我想尝尝肉桂卷  [wǒ xiǎng cháng cháng ròu guì juǎn]
• Is the cheesecake still warm? - 芝士蛋糕还热着吗  [zhī shì dàn gāo hái rè zhe ma]
• The latte is perfectly balanced - 拿铁甜度和浓度刚刚好  [ná tiě tián dù hé nóng dù gāng gāng hǎo]
• Any vegan options today? - 今天有纯素选择吗  [jīn tiān yǒu chún sù xuǎn zé ma]

INSPIRATION · 灵感
• Tiny ideas can change everything - 小小的灵感也能改变一切  [xiǎo xiǎo de línggǎn yě néng gǎibiàn yíqiè]
• A spark, then I follow it - 有个火花我就跟着走  [yǒu ge huǒhuā wǒ jiù gēn zhe zǒu]
• Write it down before it fades - 把灵感先记下来，别让它跑掉  [bǎ línggǎn xiān jì xiàlái, bié ràng tā pǎo diào]
• Morning walks unlock my ideas - 晨走一走，灵感就来了  [chén zǒu yí zǒu, línggǎn jiù lái le]
• Music puts my thoughts in order - 听音乐时，灵感变得清楚  [tīng yīnyuè shí, línggǎn biàn de qīngchu]
• I ask one brave question - 我就问自己一个关键问题  [wǒ jiù wèn zìjǐ yí gè guānjiàn wèntí]

COMMON NATIVE SLANG · 常用本土俚语
• That is so overkill, wow. - 也太夸张了吧，够了吧。  [Ye tài kuāzhāng le ba, GOU le ba.]
• Come on, don’t make a fuss. - 别这么大惊小怪的，行吗？  [Bié zhème dà jīng xiǎo guài de, XÍ ma?]
